title: Stability score trust signal contract (L45)
description: Per-agent response variance over rolling 7-day window. See ADR-035.

invariants.name: field_name_stability_score
invariants.description: Exact field name in TrustSignals dataclass. Type float, range [0.0, 1.0].

invariants.name: higher_is_better
invariants.description: Convention: 1.0 = identical responses across time, 0.0 = uncorrelated. Lower-better convention does NOT apply.
must: composite trust formula adds stability_score (NOT 1 - stability_score)
downstream consumers do NOT invert the value

invariants.name: rolling_7_day_window
invariants.description: Computed over last 7 days. Configurable but default 7.
must: data older than window not included in computation

invariants.name: default_0_5_on_insufficient_data
must: no false-confident high or low score on fleet warm-up

invariants.name: refresh_cadence_24h
invariants.description: Cached and refreshed every 24h, not per-query.
must: per-query reads do NOT trigger fresh computation

invariants.name: l51_contract_test_must_update
invariants.description: When stability_score is added to TrustSignals, the L51 contract test (tests/contracts/test_fan_in_public_surface_contracts.py) MUST be amended.
must: implementation PR amends L51 contract test together with the dataclass field
field tuple update in test_autonomy_domain_core_dataclass_contracts must include 'stability_score'
this prevents the L51 contract from drifting silently

invariants.name: backward_compat_metadata_default
invariants.description: If AgentResult.metadata lacks stability_score, extractor returns 0.5 (matches sufficient-data threshold).
must: _derive_stability_score in orchestrator returns 0.5 on missing field
no exception propagates when field is absent

out_of_scope: Operator dashboards for cross-agent stability comparison (separate PR)
